g.text: HeatProof: Canonical System Architecture & Proof Lifecycle
Verifiable Proof-of-Adaptation Network for Extreme-Heat Relief Infrastructure • IEEE ClimateChain Entry
No raw media uploaded • No fake EVM hashes • Explorer URLs require real confirmed receipts
Live ambient temperature, RH%, UV, wind
EXIF GPS tags stripped in browser RAM
• Zero Direct State Assignment in UI
All state derived deterministically from events
Observations do NOT increment attestation count
HI ≥ 42°C accelerates outage quorum to N = 1
Reporter address rejected; duplicate addresses filtered
Generated ONLY from verified persisted events
Coupled directly to active meteorological hazard window
• Real Arbiscan link only on confirmed receipt
• Operates fail-safe with local proof log queue
• Transparent Provenance Display for Every Facility
Displays exact latest observation, submitter address, and coarsened coords
Breakdown of valid witness attestations and rejected Sybil submissions
Human-readable explanation of why facility is VERIFIED, PROPOSED, or DISPUTED
Truthful Arbiscan link rendered ONLY when confirmed on chain
Monitors functional relief density relative to population heat risk
• Priority Outage Queue (Sorted by Active Heat Index)
Accelerates municipal technician dispatch to severe heat zones
Schema-validated reproducible bundle with SHA-256 integrity root
Caches shell and seed facilities for offline navigation; explicit degraded label
Zero violations found across WCAG 2.2 AA in tested states
Zero automatic state or ledger mutation
